original_test_intent: Verify the mapped BlueField Ethernet port physically shows blinking green during activity and solid green when linked.
original_method: Map the exact physical port and LED legend; establish an approved link partner and known traffic stimulus; have an operator capture timestamped photos/video of idle linked and active states; optionally correlate read-only counters; preserve logs and restore the setup.
manual_activity: Operator identifies the physical port, creates linked-idle and active-traffic states and records solid/blinking green visual evidence.
required_inputs: Authoritative LED legend for hardware revision
Approved link partner and traffic generator
Operator and timestamped visual evidence path
safety_requirements: Do not infer color/blink from software
Stop on link loss, wrong port or ambiguous indication; no auto-retry

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command can satisfy the visual criterion; DeepSeek correctly assigns it to a person.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Optional target-bound link/counter capture may corroborate, never replace, operator photos/video.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Blinking-green activity, solid-green link-up and 10-minute allocations are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Synchronize known idle/traffic fixture states with time-stamped operator imagery and optional port counters.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact mapping, reproducible stimulus and evidence quality controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: SSH or link counters cannot establish color and blink behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Camera exposure and LED cadence may mislead; physical setup requires qualified observation.

project_override_considerations: Owner must confirm the LED legend and acceptable photo/video duration/frame rate for the precise adapter revision.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek and GPT V2 both retain the source's manual physical LED requirement.

review_improvement: Makes the human-only visual criterion reproducible and auditable while preserving its non-automatable nature.
independent_technical_reasoning: A NIC can report carrier and counters even when the wrong physical indicator, color or blink circuit is observed. Only a target-mapped human visual record under known traffic can satisfy this source criterion.
